name: US recession risk
summary: US adds 165,000 jobs in October and unemployment falls to 4.1%; Sahm indicator 0.00
state: US employers added 165,000 jobs in October against forecasts of about 65,000, and the unemployment rate fell to 4.1%, figures released on 6 Nov showed (Fox Business; BNN Bloomberg/Reuters). The real-time Sahm rule indicator is 0.00, far from the 0.5 trigger, and the 10y–2y Treasury curve was +0.35 on 6 Nov (FRED).
for_you: The US labour market is still adding jobs; recession indicators are not flashing.

sources.title: Fox Business — Nasdaq rises as AI and chip stocks recover
BNN Bloomberg (Reuters) — Wall Street stocks in relief rally after heavy AI-related selloff

why: A US recession drags world trade, earnings and jobs; it is the single biggest swing factor for the global cycle.
drivers: Labour market, consumer spending, credit conditions, rates and fiscal policy.

rubric.alert: Sahm ≥ 0.50, or two consecutive negative GDP quarters, or NBER declares recession.
rubric.watch: Sahm 0.30–0.49, or one negative GDP quarter, or payrolls negative in a release.
rubric.normal: Sahm rule indicator < 0.30 and no negative GDP quarter in the latest two releases.
